# vBlueTech

> vBlueTech builds AI voice receptionists, AI chat agents and custom websites for small businesses in the United States, serving local businesses such as restaurants, cafes and coffee shops, auto repair shops, home services (plumbing, electrical, roofing, cleaning, landscaping), HVAC, dental practices, med spas, real estate agents, salons and barbershops, law offices, clinics and chiropractors, and fitness studios.

## Services
- AI Voice Agents: an AI receptionist that answers calls 24/7, handles common questions, books appointments and routes urgent calls to the business's team.
- AI Chat Agents: a website chat assistant trained on the business that answers questions, qualifies leads and collects contact details.
- Custom Websites: fast, mobile-friendly websites that make it easy for customers to call, chat or book.

## Pages
- [Home](https://vbluetech.com/): overview of services, industries and how it works
- [Services](https://vbluetech.com/services/): details on AI voice agents, AI chat agents and custom websites
- [Industries](https://vbluetech.com/industries/): restaurants, cafes, auto repair, home services, HVAC, dental, med spas, real estate, salons, law offices, clinics, fitness studios and other local businesses
- [Request a quote](https://vbluetech.com/#quote): every project is custom; quotes are prepared after a short conversation, based on website size, AI voice agent setup, call minutes, languages, chat agent, integrations and ongoing support. No fixed prices are published.
- [Contact](https://vbluetech.com/contact/): book a demo, request a quote or email
